title: A flaw in the BMC RAKP+ implementation may allow an attacker to send a request followed by a specially crafted RAKP…
description: A vulnerability in the BMC RAKP+ implementation allows an attacker to send a request followed by a specially crafted RAKP message to establish an RMCP+ session. This session could then be used to execute commands on the affected system. The flaw has a CVSS score of 7.4, indicating high severity.
